svg.aria-label: Before you start: Nineteen hours. Nine agents. One talk. The narrator's opening, the nine members' cards with their hellos, security's empty chair, and the closing line
svg.text: Nineteen hours. Nine agents. One talk.
Hi, I am Dinis Cruz. On 29 October 2026 I gave a talk in London called
The Ultimate Insider. A little after midnight that morning, its
presentation did not exist. It was an empty project folder.
By the evening it was a website: a player I pressed play on, animations
that showed what I used to explain over still pictures, and every number
checked against its source. It was built by me and a team of nine AI
agents, working through the night and the morning while I was away, and
through the afternoon while I asked for change after change. Sixteen
minutes before the talk was due, I stopped them all.
This book is how we did it. The talk was what the team happened to make
that day; the workflow behind it is the part I most want to show you,
because you can build one too. Meet the team.
And one chair at the table stays empty: security's, planned in the first
hour and never filled on the day.
